import kit

# ---------------- module + declaration order ----------------
types = [
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "E1", "kind": "enum", "values": ["p"]},
    {"name": "E2", "kind": "enum", "values": ["q"]},
    {"name": "S1", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f", "E1"], ["g", "E2"]]},
    {"name": "AL", "kind": "alias", "target": "S1"},
    {"name": "AR", "kind": "array", "element": "S1", "size": 2},
    {"name": "S2", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["h", "AR"], ["k", "AL"]]},
]
modules = [
    {"name": "Z", "params": [["p", "S2"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "A", "params": [["p", "E1"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "B", "params": [["p", "E2"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "C", "params": [["p", "AL"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "F", "params": [["x", "S2"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
    {"name": "Unused", "params": [["p", "E1"]], "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None},
]
calls = [["Z", "A"], ["Z", "A"], ["Z", "B"], ["A", "C"], ["B", "C"]]
pipes = [{"target": "Z", "filter": "F", "bind": {"x": "p"}}]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls, "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["Z"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print("modules", plan["modules"])
print("types  ", plan["types"])
assert plan["modules"] == ["C", "A", "B", "F", "Z"], plan["modules"]
# S2 -> field h: array of S1 (E1, E2, S1) ; field k: alias AL -> S1 (already), AL
assert plan["types"] == ["E1", "E2", "S1", "AL", "S2", "F" and "S2"], plan["types"]
assert plan["types"] == ["E1", "E2", "S1", "AL", "S2"], plan["types"]
assert plan["flag"] == "x4", plan
assert plan["variables"] == 5

# entry with no pipes at all keeps flag null
campaign2 = dict(campaign, pipes=[])
out2, plan2 = kit.plan_for(campaign2)
assert plan2["flag"] is None and plan2["variables"] == 4

# ---------------- lexicographic preparation ----------------
types2 = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": ["P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "T"]},
          {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 0},
          {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
mods2 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
          "requires": None}]
base = {"types": types2, "modules": mods2, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
        "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}


def prepare_case(transitions, target, want_commands, want_cost):
    machine = {"states": ["P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "T"], "initial": "P0",
               "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
               "transitions": transitions}
    campaign = dict(base, machine=machine, runs=[])
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    index = ["P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "T"].index(target)
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [index, 0])])}]
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    if not out["corpus"]:
        got = None
    else:
        got = (out["corpus"][0]["commands"], out["corpus"][0]["cost"])
    print(target, got, "want", (want_commands, want_cost))
    assert got == (want_commands, want_cost), (got, want_commands)


def t(frm, to, cmd, cost):
    return {"from": frm, "to": to, "command": cmd, "cost": cost, "when": None}


# equal cost, equal length: lexicographic command sequence decides
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P1", "T", "z", 1),
              t("P0", "P2", "b", 1), t("P2", "T", "a", 1)], "T", ["a", "z"], 2)
# greedy must skip a smaller command that dead-ends
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P1", "P3", "c", 1), t("P1", "T", "z", 1)],
             "T", ["a", "z"], 2)
# fewer commands wins over a lexicographically smaller sequence
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P1", "T", "a", 1), t("P0", "T", "z", 2)],
             "T", ["a", "a"], 2)
# total cost dominates everything
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P1", "T", "a", 1), t("P0", "T", "z", 1)],
             "T", ["z"], 1)
# layer sets must track several states at once
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P0", "P2", "a", 1),
              t("P1", "T", "y", 1), t("P2", "T", "b", 1)], "T", ["a", "b"], 2)
# cycles never break the search
prepare_case([t("P0", "P1", "a", 1), t("P1", "P0", "b", 1), t("P1", "T", "c", 5),
              t("P0", "T", "d", 8)], "T", ["a", "c"], 6)
print("ORDER OK")
PYEOF
